before.content:
<!-- layout: title; theme: briefing; design: v1 -->
# The intake pilot

A shorter review cycle, with an unanswered quality question. [1][2]

---

<!-- layout: composed -->
<!-- scene:  -->
## The pilot measured time; quality remains unknown [1][2]

In this synthetic intake pilot, median review time was 40 hours before the pilot and 16 hours during the pilot. The observation covered two teams over eight weeks. These are training data, not actual organizational results. [1]

The two-team intake pilot did not measure review quality or error rates. A faster review cannot establish a quality improvement. The sample does not establish an effect in other teams. [2]

findings.problem: Title and subtitle sit in the upper-left third with a large empty field below, which makes the opening page feel top-heavy next to the fuller second page.
findings.correction: Lower the title/subtitle block slightly toward the optical centre, or add a small source/hand-off line in the lower area, to balance the page.

findings.problem: The limitation paragraph (b2) is set at 25px versus 32px for the time-result paragraph (b1) and sits after an ~90px gap, so the 'not measured' content reads as footnote-level material even though it carries the slide's main caveat.
findings.correction: Set b2 at the same size and weight as b1 (or give it an explicit label such as 'What was not measured') and tighten the vertical gap so the two paragraphs read as peers rather than body plus footnote.

beforeFindings.problem: The composed elements do not fit this page at a readable size.
beforeFindings.correction: Repair the scene using the existing content blocks.

beforeFindings.problem: The first paragraph's citation marker "[1]" has wrapped onto a line of its own at the left margin under "…not actual organizational results.", leaving an isolated glyph that reads as a stray artifact.
beforeFindings.correction: Keep the marker attached to the sentence it sources (or drop it), so no citation sits alone on a line; re-check the paragraph wrap afterwards.

beforeFindings.problem: The headline carries its own source markers "[1][2]", which duplicate the citations already given in the body and clutter the bold two-line title.
beforeFindings.correction: Remove the bracketed markers from the headline and leave sourcing in the body text where the claims are made.

beforeFindings.problem: The core result (median review time 40 hours before, 16 hours during the pilot) is buried mid-sentence in a dense paragraph, so collaborators must read the prose to find the number the deck exists to report.
beforeFindings.correction: Pull "40 hours → 16 hours" out as a short emphasized figure or pull-quote above the paragraph, keeping the surrounding qualifiers (synthetic data, two teams, eight weeks) intact.
